critical_code_review_comments: scan.py L11 keeps `import re  # noqa: F401` with a comment about BUG-025 removing the only call — the module is actually clean of direct re usage now; the import can be dropped on next refactor pass. Non-blocking.

normalize_phone() in core/phone.py L32: `unchanged = digits == raw_s and (cc_in or INDIA_CC) == cc` compares digits to the raw string before strip of + and spaces, so status will almost always be 'fixed' for anything other than a plain 10-digit input. The code uses `pstatus == 'fixed'` only to persist phone_raw; behaviour is correct and all tests pass, but the 'ok' branch is effectively unreachable for any input that had a leading + or 0. Worth clarifying in comments or renaming the status enum. Non-blocking.

Lookup IP bucket key is 'ip:<ip>' while skip-otp uses 'so-ip:<ip>' / 'so-ph:<...>' — two different prefix conventions for the same collection. Not a bug (regexes in tests disambiguate), but a single convention (lu-ip/lu-ph vs so-ip/so-ph) would be more consistent.
